intro: Every job on this page is a real property in North Georgia, photographed the way anybody actually sees it — from the street, at night, with the lights on. We shoot our own work rather than licensing manufacturer photography, because the thing you are buying is what your house looks like at nine in the evening, and a rendering cannot tell you that. Look at the rooflines: the track follows the architecture rather than cutting across it, the runs stop where the eye expects them to stop, and there is no wire visible anywhere. That is the part that takes the time.
